title: Statusline guards

bubbles.title: Guard count segment
bubbles.hint: Append '   ¦ N guards' after the rendered line (1 guard / N guards), no separator: the same 3-space gap the line uses between F and prev/active/next. Icon is sym.guard (ascii !), dim like the context part. Boundary: src/cli/statusline.ts + src/lib/render/ (line.ts or a small helper); nothing in show/switch output.

bubbles.title: Statusline tests
bubbles.hint: Extend test/hooks.test.js: no guards (unchanged), 1 guard (singular), several guards, --ascii. Then npm run build + npm test (sandbox: unpack Linux tsc/esbuild per AGENTS.md first).
